solution:
The correct mirror image of the given figure when the mirror is held on the right side.

__Detailed Explanation:__

__
 
• The correct mirror image of the given figure is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f878f67e5f8f50be9536e6732c7437d9b23cc42e7fb76d1324372780e639999d.png] " the second alphabet of the given image is 'J' and the correct mirror image of this alphabet is ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eaec1763634aea50ccd97435d3c161a7659193f7d496d32e775d0f256cbe943d.png] ' but it is wrongly given in Option 1 and Option 3 so it is eliminated.
 
• The correct mirror image of the given figure is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17662bd5eea9f62352b642f1933f3cb05470b77fd2f0a320e9a629ac4a1b70f9.png] " the first letter of the given image is ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99a22064e1104b88b77a62f5a3b4b10b304c7edb16dbcc673b7454e6c15dd212.png] ' and the correct mirror image of this alphabet is ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99a22064e1104b88b77a62f5a3b4b10b304c7edb16dbcc673b7454e6c15dd212.png] ' but it is wrongly given in Option 2 so it is eliminated.

 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

2) In a real given mirror image the farthest number or alphabet appears closest in the mirror image.
